Investors centre

Welcome to Smiths Investor Relations

In this section you’ll find all you need to know about our value proposition, our performance, regulatory news and related shareholder information.

Smiths is a focused, premium industrial engineering company

We are a high-quality business with strong financial flexibility and a clear opportunity to deliver sustainable growth and attractive returns for shareholders.

We have strong market positions with clear competitive advantages, growth prospects and world-class engineering expertise. We have a clear strategy for growth, and our talented people have the capabilities to succeed.

The sales of Smiths Interconnect and Smiths Detection in FY2026 at attractive valuations generated £3.3bn of enterprise value. These divestments materially strengthened our financial position and have given us greater capacity to invest in growth while returning substantial capital to shareholders.
